blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu businessman and philanthropist Ricarido Delfin King, who built a business career rooted in family, faith, and service, has died. He was 77. The University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) mourned King’s passing, remembering him as a “distinguished business leader and philanthropist” who received an honorary degree of Doctor in Business Management, honoris causa, from the university in 2024. The university conferred the degree in recognition of his contributions to the community.
